source.title: Collection of Object-Centric Event Logs (OCEL 2.0 relational SQLite)

serial_latency.aggregation: pooled p50/p95 with retained per-epoch p50/p95/min/max and epoch p95 median/range
serial_latency.raw_evidence: positive integer nanosecond samples and realized randomized arm-order codes

method.latency_scope: database extraction plus client materialization, model construction, and scoring
method.correctness_gate: three-way canonical answer equality before sample acceptance

concurrency.connection_model: prestarted process workers with one persistent PostgreSQL connection per worker; connection setup and pool startup excluded
concurrency.warmup_gate: one exact canonical warmup response from every worker PID
concurrency.correctness_gate: exact canonical equality for every measured request
concurrency.aggregation: median epoch QPS and median epoch p50/p95/p99; every epoch retained
concurrency.arm_order: deterministic rotation by dataset, worker level, and epoch

method.memory_model: fresh process baseline and peak RSS including engine import and one request
method.vanilla_index_policy: relational integrity indexes plus one workload secondary B-tree, ocel_e2o_object
